_comment: EXAMPLE semantic layer for the fintech demo (orders + payments in Postgres). This is the user-authored 'metric tree': each metric carries its decomposition into driver metrics via depends_on, so RCA is a systematic walk. Drop a file like this at fabric/<schema>/semantic_layer.json (or pass Workspace.load(semantic_layer_path=...)). Descriptions/SQL are illustrative for the seeded demo data.

new_customer.description: A customer whose first-ever order falls within the period under analysis.
new_customer.sql: orders.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING MIN(order_ts) >= :period_start)

returning_customer.description: A customer who placed an order in the period but whose first-ever order predates it.
returning_customer.sql: orders.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING MIN(order_ts) < :period_start)

revenue.description: Total captured payment amount over the period.
revenue.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE o.order_ts BETWEEN :period_start AND :period_end

order_volume.description: Count of distinct orders placed in the period.
order_volume.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM orders WHERE order_ts BETWEEN :period_start AND :period_end

new_customer_volume.description: Distinct orders in the period placed by new customers (first-ever order in period).
new_customer_volume.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM orders o WHERE o.order_ts BETWEEN :period_start AND :period_end AND o.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING MIN(order_ts) >= :period_start)

returning_customer_volume.description: Distinct orders in the period placed by returning customers.
returning_customer_volume.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM orders o WHERE o.order_ts BETWEEN :period_start AND :period_end AND o.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING MIN(order_ts) < :period_start)

avg_unit_price.description: Average captured amount per order line (price component of AOV).

segment_mix.description: Share of order volume by customer segment / region (mix component of AOV). A driver spanning the lake customers dimension.

method.description: Payment method on the payments table.
